proof_body:
by
  intro R _ x n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have shift : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k : R) * (Nat.stirlingSecond n k : R)) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - (i : R)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (((k + 1 : ℕ) : R) * (Nat.stirlingSecond n (k + 1) : R)) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - (i : R)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ _ n, Nat.stirlingSecond_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
      simp
    have step : ∀ k, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - (i : R))) * x = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - (i : R)) + (k : R) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - (i : R)) := by
      intro k; rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]; ring
    have hr : ∀ k, (((n + 1).stirlingSecond (k + 1) : ℕ) : R) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : R) * (n.stirlingSecond (k + 1) : R) + (n.stirlingSecond k : R) := by
      intro k; rw [Nat.stirlingSecond_succ_succ]; push_cast; ring
    rw [pow_succ, ih, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (n + 1), Nat.stirlingSecond_succ_zero]
    simp only [hr, add_mul, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← shift, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [mul_assoc, step]; ring
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (x : R) (n : ℕ), x ^ n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.stirlingSecond n k : R) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - (i : R))
